'''FC Fushë Kosova''' ({{langx|sq|Klubi Futbollistik Fushë Kosova}}) is a [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Kosovo Polje]], [[Kosovo]].{{ref label|status|a|}} The club has played in the second division of football in Kosovo, [[First Football League of Kosovo]], during the 2005–06 season. However, they won promotion to the top tier of football in Kosovo, the [[Football Superleague of Kosovo]], for the 2006–07 season."}}
